items.title: Covariance construction prerequisite: a positive rank-one complement

source.edition: OAI adc7f124; ASTIS authored covariance prerequisite v1
source.anchor: lem:compiler-absorption covariance construction, not full lemma
source.attribution: ASTIS-authored generalized construction motivated by the pinned OAI proof. Standard rank-one operator mathematics; no research novelty or complete source-lemma credit.

items.statement: Let E be a complete real inner-product space and let u in E satisfy ||u||<=1. There exists a continuous real-linear operator P:E->E that is positive (self-adjoint with nonnegative quadratic form) and satisfies P*P+u u*=I, where u u* sends x to <u,x>u. Zero vectors and the singular unit-norm boundary are included; finite dimension is not required.
assumptions: E is a complete real inner-product space; finite-dimensional real source slot spaces satisfy completeness automatically.
u is a vector with ||u||<=1. In the paper u=v/(2Ds), and source assumptions give the stronger bound ||u||<=1/2.
No square-root witness, covariance identity, Gaussian law, invertibility or nonzero-vector assumption is supplied.

obligations.label: Produce a positive covariance complement from the vector norm bound

bindings.boundary: An explicit covariance producer, not the whole Gaussian absorption lemma. Principal matrix-square-root identification, scaling, block seed law and physical-query translation remain separate.

assumption_deltas.source: Source slot space is finite-dimensional, u=v/(2Ds) has norm<=1/2. The covariance square root is constructed.
assumption_deltas.lean: Complete real inner-product space, norm u<=1; constructs positive P with exact adjoint-product covariance.
assumption_deltas.reason: This is an authored prerequisite, not the full source lemma. It weakens the source norm bound and allows arbitrary complete real Hilbert spaces; scaling and block/seed semantics are not claimed.
